goal: Shrink Bitcoin Core's non-GUI release binaries by disabling unused libstdc++ wchar_t and zoneinfo support
Saves download size and hosting bandwidth for every user who fetches release binaries
reviewability: Review #36272 first because this PR builds on its toolchain-splitting refactor
Author is actively engaged and three reviewers independently verified reproducible builds, so review now is worthwhile
agreement: Strong support with a Concept ACK after an earlier alternative proposal was retracted as incorrect (hebasto)
Verified by independently matching reproducible Guix build hashes (willcl-ark, rustaceanrob)
No unresolved objections remain in the discussion

categories.name: build
why: P3 because the benefit is a small, verified ~0.5MB binary-size reduction across non-GUI binaries
Reproducibility confirmed by three independent builds, giving it some technical leverage
Also refactors toolchain code that other in-flight PRs like #25573 can reuse, but the core payoff stays a minor optimization
